import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df_thr = pd.read_csv\('data/sensitivity/final_sweep_threshold.csv'\)
df_sg = pd.read_csv\('data/sensitivity/final_sweep_seq_gate.csv'\)

print\('=== SWEEP A: Threshold \(seq_gate=0.3\) ==='\)
print\(f'{\\"Threshold\\":<10} {\\"N\(OD\)\\":>8} {\\"Train ρ²\\":>10} {\\"Test ρ²\\":>10} {\\"FPR\\":>8} {\\"RMSE\\":>8} {\\"gap\\":>8}'\)
print\('-'*65\)
for _, r in df_thr.iterrows\(\):
    gap = r['train_rho_sq'] - r['test_rho_sq']
    mark = ' <--' if r['threshold'] == 0.5 else ''
    print\(f'{r[\\"threshold\\"]:<10.1f} {r[\\"n_ods\\"]:>8,.0f} {r[\\"train_rho_sq\\"]:>10.4f} {r[\\"test_rho_sq\\"]:>10.4f} {r[\\"test_fpr\\"]*100:>7.1f}% {r[\\"test_rmse\\"]:>8.4f} {gap:>+8.4f}{mark}'\)

print\(\)
print\('=== SWEEP B: Seq Gate \(threshold=0.5\) ==='\)
print\(f'{\\"Seq Gate\\":<10} {\\"N\(OD\)\\":>8} {\\"Train ρ²\\":>10} {\\"Test ρ²\\":>10} {\\"FPR\\":>8} {\\"RMSE\\":>8} {\\"gap\\":>8}'\)
print\('-'*65\)
for _, r in df_sg.iterrows\(\):
    gap = r['train_rho_sq'] - r['test_rho_sq']
    mark = ' <--' if r['min_seq'] == 0.3 else ''
    print\(f'{r[\\"min_seq\\"]:<10.1f} {r[\\"n_ods\\"]:>8,.0f} {r[\\"train_rho_sq\\"]:>10.4f} {r[\\"test_rho_sq\\"]:>10.4f} {r[\\"test_fpr\\"]*100:>7.1f}% {r[\\"test_rmse\\"]:>8.4f} {gap:>+8.4f}{mark}'\)

print\(\)
print\('=== Beta Stability across sweeps ==='\)
betas = ['beta_IVT','beta_access','beta_transfers','beta_bus','beta_train']
for sweep_name, df_s in [\('Threshold', df_thr\), \('Seq Gate', df_sg\)]:
    print\(f'  [{sweep_name}]'\)
    for b in betas:
        vals = df_s[b].values
        m = np.mean\(vals\)
        cv = np.std\(vals\)/abs\(m\)*100 if abs\(m\)>1e-10 else 0
        print\(f'    {b:>18}: mean={m:>10.6f}  CV={cv:>5.1f}%'\)
    print\(\)
